system.name: Conventional controller
system.explanation: The fixed conventional worker chooses native skills, requests assistance when its public rule cannot progress, then resumes after protected handback. Its behavior is recorded in the world lane.

system.name: Protected supervisor
system.explanation: The protected supervisor grants exclusive ownership, checks epochs and budgets, and keeps request, dispatch, terminal state and public support separate. Gateway receipt status alone does not establish task success.

system.name: Robot and world
system.explanation: MuJoCo physics advances while the model runs. The world lane records sensor observations, command dispatch, public effects and authority transitions. Display sampling does not invent intermediate observations.

system.name: Independent evaluator
system.explanation: The independent evaluator checks completed orders, recipe and inspection provenance, settled placement and violations. Outcome and lifecycle evidence are available below each episode.

system.name: Robot-Codex
system.explanation: Robot-Codex reads its configured files, uses public observations and writes scripts or continuity within the isolated invocation. The model lane contains retained public messages and completed tool items; it does not reconstruct private reasoning.
